The '''Tikath system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tikath]].
